_readme: Every outside company or host this site sends visitor data to. loads=browser: the visitor's browser contacts these hosts; the compliance guard fails on any browser request to a host not listed here, and on any waitsForConsent host that is contacted before consent. loads=server: data our server or hosting passes on (never contacted by the browser). Every vendor must be named in the privacy policy at policySection. Change this file, app/privacy/page.tsx (and its Last updated date) and the CSP in next.config.ts in the same pull request.

trackers.purpose: Hosting, content delivery and server logs
trackers.data: IP address, user agent, requested URL, time of request

trackers.purpose: Delivers contact form submissions to the site owner's inbox
trackers.data: Name, email address and message typed into the contact form
